title: Wind noise and vent shortcomings
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on noticeable wind noise around windows, mirrors and pillars, plus complaints about noisy or limited ventilation and missing rear vents.

positive.summary: One positive review still praises the car overall while noting minor wind noise and a small cabin rattle.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe severe wind noise from front windows, noisy ventilation with limited vent control, and the lack of rear vents as unacceptable.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention wind noise around doors, wing mirrors and screen pillars, loud ventilation, brake noise, and missing rear heating vents without a clear overall sentiment label.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in describing the balance of opinion.
The topic cluster mixes several related but distinct subjects, including aerodynamic wind noise, ventilation noise and control, brake noise, and missing rear vents.
